subject: Hillside Lane
comment: I would like to voice my opinion of the project on the north end of Hillside Lane. My husband and I feel like the Balli’s and Flygare’s feel. Hillside Lane is a very small road which is very narrow especially on the curb. The road slopes toward the west where the ditch is. It is extremely dangerous in the winter with ice on the road. There is no good place to park on Hillside Lane. Adding more homes and traffic will make this street very dangerous. We feel like Hillside Lane has already become busier with traffic, biker’s and those who walk. We feel our street would become even busier and more dangerous to everyone. There are a number of young people who use this street, and we want them to be safe. We hope you will consider these concerns. Earlier this year a 5 year old boy was hit by a car on Neffs Lane, he did not survive. A very sad time and still is on our mind. We want children and adults be safe on these streets. They are already hazardous. Don’t make it worse for ourselves and our families. Thank You Kris and Becky Rosander
